location_qualifier: Red Beach; 35th RCT landing, first element of the division
composing_text: The first of the division infantry combat teams landed this day; the other two followed in the next three weeks (Miller, chapter IX).
source_locator: R2225: ch. IX; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: Miller, ch. IX, and Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9: the 35th Regimental Combat Team landed at Beach Red on 17 December 1942, the first element of the 25th Division. This row is the start of the division’s landing, not a claim that the whole division was ashore on 17 December. Confidence 0.7.

location_qualifier: Galloping Horse; XIV Corps first January offensive
composing_text: The infantry regiment on the division right (north) against the Galloping Horse, as described in Miller, chapters XI–XII.
source_locator: R2225: ch. XI; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: The 25th Infantry Division attacked the Galloping Horse at 0635 on 10 January 1943 (Miller, ch. XI). Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9, independently record that Army units began their attacks against the Galloping Horse on 10 January, with final actions there three days later. Old confidence was 0.5, from Miller only. New confidence is 0.7, because a second official family (usmc_history) agrees on the 10 January opening.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XI; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
current_activity: completing the capture of the Galloping Horse
notes: The 25th Infantry Division completed the capture after the 27th Infantry cleared Sims Ridge and completed the capture of the Galloping Horse on 13 January 1943 (Miller, ch. XI). Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9, independently record that the final actions on the Galloping Horse came three days after the 10 January opening. Old confidence was 0.5, from Miller only. New confidence is 0.7, because a second official family (usmc_history) agrees on the 13 January completion.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XIV, 25th Division's Preliminary Movements
current_activity: attacking west from the Galloping Horse toward Kokumbona
notes: Miller, ch. XIV: on 20 January Collins ordered the 25th Division to attack west from the Galloping Horse on 22 January, the 27th Infantry delivering a holding attack and the 161st Infantry making the division's main effort. The attack opened that day as part of the XIV Corps offensive. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XIV, Second Day: The Capture of Kokumbona; R2226: ch. IX, The Final Drive
notes: Miller, ch. XIV, and Zimmerman, ch. IX, agree that the American drive took Kokumbona on 23 January 1943. Miller names the 27th Infantry of the 25th Division as the regiment that entered the village that afternoon. Confidence 0.7.
